blocks.text: The award-winning Filipino adult-animated documentary “58th” will screen for a week in Glendale, California, from Oct. 23 to 29. Directed by Carl Joseph Papa, “58th” tells the story of the victims of the 2009 Maguindanao massacre, which killed dozens of journalists. The film also highlights efforts to recognize photojournalist Reynaldo “Bebot” Momay as the massacre’s […]...
